title: Filament Admin Panels
intro: Applies to: Filament `Resource` classes, pages, actions, widgets, panel policies, panel service providers, and their tests. Only relevant when the codebase uses Filament; skip this family entirely otherwise.

Lane boundaries: the admin panel as a separate application surface (own read/write models, own enums, own guard, no cross-surface imports or event subscriptions) is owned by `isolation.md`; class shape and DI by `orchestration-di.md`; gateway rules by `integrations.md`. Cross-reference them, do not re-audit here.

entries.rule: Every resource **MUST** ship a `{Resource}ResourceServiceProvider` whose `boot()` binds the policy to the resource's read model: `Gate::policy(OrderReadModel::class, OrderPolicy::class)`. A resource with no provider, or a provider that registers the resource but never binds its policy, is incomplete.
The resource's command/handler pairs **MUST** be wired via `Bus::map([...])` in that same provider.
Exception: a resource managing a third-party package's model (e.g. Spatie's `Role`) **MAY** gate the vendor model directly, since no read model of its own exists.
entries.why: no read model of its own exists
applies_to: a resource managing a third-party package's model

entries.rule: A resource's write capability **MUST** live in a nested action folder holding a `{Action}Command`, `{Action}CommandHandler`, and a past-tense fact event named `*ByAdmin` (use `*ByPlatformAdmin` where "admin" already means something else in that context, e.g. team admins).

The handler **MUST** mutate through the panel's write model, never a `*ReadModel`, and **MUST** dispatch the fact event only after the write succeeds. An event named as intent (`*RequestedByAdmin`) or dispatched before the mutation is a violation.
Pages and actions **MUST** dispatch the command (from `->using()` closures or page hooks), never mutate state inline in the page/action class.
Provider-touching flows (payments, external systems) **MUST** go through the panel's own gateway, never a raw connector inline (see `integrations.md`).

A resource's `table()`, `form()`, and `infolist()` **MUST** delegate to static sibling helper classes (`OrdersTable::configure($table)`, `UserForm::configure($schema)`, `OrderInfolist::configure($schema)`), never carry the full component tree inline in the resource class.

A read-only resource exposes **List + View only** (`ListRecords` + `ViewRecord`, an `infolist()`, no `form()`). A CUD resource exposes **List/Create/Edit** with a `form()`, its pages dispatching commands. A half-pattern **MUST NOT** exist: no `form()` growing on a read-only resource, no CUD resource missing its form or create/edit pages.
Every policy method **MUST** type its first argument against the panel's own principal model (`Admin $admin`), never the customer app's `User` and never `mixed`.

checks.coverage: Flags a policy method whose first argument is not typed against the panel's own principal model, including `User` and `mixed`.

entries.note: A read-only resource's policy defines `viewAny` + `view` only; a CUD resource adds `create`/`update`/`delete`, with a self-guard where it matters (`delete()` returns `$admin->id !== $user->id`).

entries.rule: A stats widget **MUST** dispatch a `*StatsQuery` and build its stats from the typed result inside `getStats()`, never query the database or models directly.

checks.coverage: Flags an Eloquent model or database call inside a stats widget getStats() method.

entries.rule: Widgets **MUST** disable polling (`$pollingInterval = null`) unless live data is explicitly required and justified.
allowed_in: live data is explicitly required and justified

checks.coverage: Flags a widget whose $pollingInterval is not null.

sections.heading: Version-sensitive imports (Filament v4+)
intro: Easy to get wrong against older docs; flag when violated:

entries.note: Actions (`EditAction`, `DeleteAction`, `CreateAction`, `DeleteBulkAction`, `BulkActionGroup`, `ViewAction`) import from `Filament\Actions`, **not** `Filament\Tables\Actions`. Columns/filters still come from `Filament\Tables\Columns` / `Filament\Tables\Filters`.

checks.coverage: Flags a panel enum that does not implement HasLabel and HasColor.

entries.rule: A `TextInput` holding a snowflake or other large integer id **MUST NOT** use `->numeric()` (float precision silently corrupts the value); use `->rules(['integer', 'min:1'])`.
entries.why: float precision silently corrupts the value

checks.coverage: Flags a TextInput that calls ->numeric() on an id field.

entries.rule: Filament tests drive pages with `Livewire::test(...)`, call `Filament::setCurrentPanel(...)` in `setUp()`, and view-page tests **MUST** assert the displayed fields, not just that the page renders. General test rules are owned by `testing.md`.
entries.lane_note: General test rules are owned by `testing.md`.

entries.note: A read-only resource with no `form()`; that is the correct read-only shape.
Gating a third-party model directly where no read model exists (the provider exception above).

Pages/widgets resolving the `Dispatcher` via `App::make(Dispatcher::class)` instead of constructor injection; Filament instantiates these classes itself, so this is the sanctioned exception to the DI rules.
Read-model factories being non-`final` (they rely on late static binding).
